create_session_hermes_agent: create a new session in the Hermes Agent SQLite state store with source, model, and system prompt
append_message_to_session: append a message to a Hermes Agent session with role, content, and optional tool calls
search_session_messages: search Hermes Agent session messages using FTS5 full-text search with source and role filters
list_hermes_sessions: list Hermes Agent sessions with previews, last active timestamps, and compression tip projection
prune_old_sessions: prune ended Hermes Agent sessions older than a specified number of days
